short: Anima illustration with a high-detail Tile-guided second pass

title.zh: Anima 插画·底图与 Tile 细化
title.en: Anima illustration: base and Tile detail

about.zh: 按已测试的 Anima 插画路线先出底图，再用 Tile 控制网放大细化；先确认模型、LoRA 和结果，不保证原图复刻。
about.en: Make an Anima illustration and refine a selected base with Tile guidance, checking models, LoRA and results; not a promise to reproduce a reference.

text: Use for an explicitly requested Anima illustration or this Tile-guided two-pass recipe, not as a default for unrelated models or styles. Preserve the user's text, requested character and pose; do not add an artist, style, LoRA or hidden hands unless the user asks or accepts it.

Starting point tested on RTX 4050 Laptop 6 GB: MiaoMiao Harem Anima 1.5, compatible Qwen 3 0.6B text encoder and Qwen image VAE, optional Chen bin style LoRA at model/CLIP 1.0. Verify models and LoRA compatibility; filename similarity is not file identity. The separately named MiaoMiao text encoder was not compared. Use the user's chosen model or style when specified.

Base pass: 832x1216 batch 1, 35 steps, CFG 4.4, dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu/beta, denoise 1.0, with tiled VAE if needed. Preserve and show the base; let the user select it before a further pass when selection was requested. Do not force a long second pass on an unwanted base.

For an Anima canvas with the tested Anima Tile Repair v2.0 weight and ComfyUI-Anima-LLLite available, add_nodes(block="upscale_anima_tile") builds the second pass: tiled VAE encode, bislerp 1.22, 30 steps, CFG 4.4, dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu/sgm_uniform, denoise 0.85, Tile 0.7 from 0 to 0.8 using the base image, tiled decode and optional ColorMatch mkl. It saves a separate result. Check the canvas and missing nodes/models first; do not silently substitute another Tile model or attach to a non-Anima model.

Use a modest single-image size and avoid simultaneous large jobs on 6 GB. 0.85 redraws substantially even with Tile: compare base and result, zoom in on important details and hands, keep the original, and let the user choose; lower denoise if preservation matters more. Three locally tested SFW base/Tiled comparisons suggest stronger composition retention, not guaranteed hand repair or a general success rate. The original reference graph also contains a Tile preprocessor that was not used in this test; its actual runtime and exact reference reproduction are unproven.

If the user asks for a controlled comparison, use the same saved base, prompt, size, seed, sampler and color matching with and without Tile. Report what actually ran, missing models, choices, and visual changes. Do not claim the LoRA alone caused the style: no weight ablation has been done.
